<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple split (model split@1): two halves of the section, the copy (the heading, a description, up to two
  links as the actions: the first primary, the second secondary, each drawn only when its label and its address
  are both set) and one picture that fills its half to the edge of the screen (no rounding). Axes: media (end:
  the picture after the copy, start: before it).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type SplitSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  image?: string;
  imageAlt?: string;
  imageSrcset?: string;
  imageDark?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  secondaryActionLabel?: string;
  secondaryActionHref?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  media?: "end" | "start";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  image,
  imageAlt,
  imageSrcset,
  imageDark,
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  secondaryActionLabel = "",
  secondaryActionHref = "",
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  media = "end",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<SplitSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="split-simple"
  >
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2">
      <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'start')"
        :alt="(imageAlt ? imageAlt : title)"
        :src="image"
        :darkSrc="imageDark"
        :srcset="imageSrcset"
        ratio="4/3"
        class="rounded-none md:aspect-auto md:h-full"
      />
      <Stack
        gap="6"
        align="start"
        justify="center"
        :class="cn(
          'px-4 md:px-8 lg:px-16',
          (
            (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
            : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
            : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
          )
        )"
      >
        <Title :as="level" size="4xl" weight="bold" class="tracking-tight" :id="titleId">
          {{ title }}
        </Title>
        <Text v-if="description" size="lg" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ description }}
        </Text>
        <Group
          v-if="((actionLabel && actionHref) || (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref))"
          gap="4"
          align="center"
          justify="start"
          class="flex-wrap"
        >
          <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
            {{ actionLabel }}
          </LinkButton>
          <LinkButton
            v-if="(secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref)"
            variant="secondary"
            size="lg"
            :href="urlOf(secondaryActionHref)"
          >
            {{ secondaryActionLabel }}
          </LinkButton>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
      <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'end')"
        :alt="(imageAlt ? imageAlt : title)"
        :src="image"
        :darkSrc="imageDark"
        :srcset="imageSrcset"
        ratio="4/3"
        class="rounded-none md:aspect-auto md:h-full"
      />
    </Box>
  </Block>
</template>
